protocol.method: Cross maps and opponents; paired seeds and both duel seats; four seats for island FFA. No tuning. Pilot used for feasibility/variance only, excluded from confirmatory analysis. Freeze confirmatory sample count before opening its outcomes. Stratify by fixed map/opponent and resample map-seed clusters with seats/opponents together. Report unresolved games and missing milestones; no favorable-result exclusions. Competitive comparison includes other-AI changes; passive normal-rule controls isolate that confound.

confirmation.selection: Pilot discordance variance .256 implies roughly 806 independent pairs for 80% power at a zero true difference under a 5-point margin; round to 864 balanced pairs. Cluster correlation can reduce actual power; report measured uncertainty without extending the cohort based on its outcomes.
confirmation.passiveSetup: Normal hunger, construction and upgrades; unchanged no-op JavaScript allies; death-only loss condition prevents an immediate allied victory. Fixed 30000-tick horizon. This isolates economic/technology pacing, not military behavior.
primaryOutcomes: duel win-rate difference, with unresolved fraction reported separately
passive population-time mean ratio; overall and by map
secondaryOutcomes: win rate by map and opponent
producer and feeding counts over time
first offensive target and observed combat damage
event attainment rates and capped event times
confirmation.uncertainty: Paired map-seed clusters; bootstrap fixed-map strata, retaining opponents and seats together. No tuning, no selective exclusions, no optional sample extension. Per-stratum results are exploratory.

analysisDetails.weights: Equal weight per map; within a map, equal weight per opponent and then seat. Duel and four-player outcomes remain separate.
analysisDetails.primaryIntervals: Two-sided 95% percentile intervals for paired differences/ratios, resampling map-seed clusters within fixed maps. Also report global-seed resampling sensitivity to cross-map correlation.
analysisDetails.equivalenceDecision: An interval must lie wholly inside the preset margin; include sensitivity intervals, unresolved games, failures and per-map exceptions in interpretation. No significance-based early stop or sample expansion.
analysisDetails.milestones: Report attainment and mean min(event tick, cohort cap), counting unobserved events at the cap. These are bounded descriptive scores, not uncensored event-time estimates. Early game termination competes with later milestones.
analysisDetails.growth: Population-time averages at a fixed 30000-tick horizon are primary only in allied passive controls. Competitive population-time means use each actual game duration and are descriptive, not proof of equal pacing.

control_protocol_amendment.reason: Death-only controls can end with living units after engine defeat. Two original controls ended before the intended 30000-tick horizon, so carrying final counts forward is not valid observed growth.
control_protocol_amendment.replacement: Repeat every one of the 256 passive-control scenarios with the same binaries, maps, seeds, seats, alliances and passive script; use script-only outcome conditions to prevent death from ending the observation window. No seed addition, removal or tuning. Competitive scenarios are unchanged.
gates: Compare ECON and MEASURE prefixes to original controls through their observed endpoints; report any mismatches
Retain original defeat times and report them separately
control_protocol_amendment.primary_estimand: Ratio of equal-map-weighted mean population over the fixed 30000-tick observation window
control_protocol_amendment.status: setup correction; no behavior aggregate results inspected

method: Equal fixed-map weights; paired bootstrap of map-seed clusters and global-seed sensitivity, 10000 replicates. Primary margins must hold for both intervals. Per-map/opponent and milestones are exploratory; no multiplicity-adjusted equivalence claim for them.
